name: sol_integrations_lsd_cbeth_2
description: Assumes cbETH/ETH exchange rate only increases, mishandling rate decreases in accounting
question: The source file in `source` integrates the cbETH/ETH exchange rate into value or collateral calculations (e.g., converting cbETH balances to ETH value) but assumes the rate is monotonically non-decreasing or hardcodes/caches it without any logic to detect, bound, or safely handle a decrease in the cbETH/ETH rate, so that a rate drop causes incorrect valuation, insolvency, or unhandled underflow/overflow in downstream calculations, excluding code that already fetches a live rate each time and correctly recomputes values whenever the rate falls.
criteria: Converts cbETH to ETH using a rate variable that is only ever updated upward, with no code path handling a lower rate
Caches the cbETH/ETH rate at deposit time and reuses it for withdrawal/liquidation math without re-checking if the rate has since decreased
Computes collateral value as cbETH balance * storedRate without any check that storedRate could be less than a previous stored value, causing stale overvaluation
Performs subtraction or division assuming rate >= previousRate, which can underflow or revert if the rate decreases
